implementation.runtime_scope: RHS assembly, temporal scaling, phasor composition, identity and sparse DOF mapping only

identity.spatial_order: node then normalized DOF; duplicate entries are summed before hashing
identity.history_order: semantic sample order; times must be finite, non-negative and strictly increasing
includes: real spatial weights keyed by physical node and normalized DOF
declared spatial, amplitude and result units
constant amplitude, piecewise-linear time samples, or complex frequency phasor
frequency in Hz and resolved angular frequency in rad/s
excludes: operator matrix contents for explicit channels
identity.operator_reuse: An excitation-only change changes the channel-set identity but does not change or invalidate PreparedDynamicSystem K/M. A bound channel map is tied to its exact operator identity and DOF signature.

spatial_temporal_separation.spatial_distribution: finite real scalar weights only; complex and non-finite values are rejected
spatial_temporal_separation.history_interpolation: piecewise linear with endpoint hold; time unit seconds

harmonic_phasor.conversion: omega = 2*pi*f once when HarmonicAmplitude is constructed

spatial_temporal_separation.unit_policy: Units, frame and sign are explicit labels. Channels are superposed only when these declared contracts match exactly; no implicit unit conversion is performed.
spatial_temporal_separation.zero_and_cancellation: Zero channels remain identified no-ops. Complex channels are combined in canonical ID order; exact and near cancellation are evaluated using absolute residual/norms near zero.
spatial_temporal_separation.factor_application: Explicit signal is multiplied by its real spatial map once. Legacy load values are assembled into the spatial map once and existing temporal factors are applied once per legacy load.

interfaces.serialization: ExcitationChannelSet.to_dict/from_dict use explicit schema and identity verification; phasors always serialize as real/imag.
interfaces.binding: ExcitationChannelSet.bind(PreparedDynamicSystem) builds an instance-local CSC map keyed by its physical DOF signature.
interfaces.projection: PreparedDynamicSystem.reduce_load applies the existing real reducer independently to real and imaginary parts; no K/M assembly or new modal projection is performed.
future_consumers: WP04 modal projection may consume full RHS
WP05 reduced harmonic may consume complex reduced RHS
WP07 base acceleration is not implemented

legacy_compatibility.legacy_adapter: ExcitationChannelSet.from_legacy_model uses GlobalAssembler.assemble_load_vectors and deterministic IDs legacy:nodal:i / legacy:distributed:i.
legacy_compatibility.distributed_load_integration: Delegated to the existing GlobalAssembler; this adapter does not change its domain or integration rules.
legacy_compatibility.per_load_temporal_factors: Existing Newmark load-function/table/sequence/per-load factor semantics are reused through NewmarkDynamicSolver helpers; one factor is composed per load vector.
legacy_compatibility.legacy_harmonic_load: A legacy real load vector is exposed as a zero-phase phasor only when an explicit requested frequency in Hz is supplied.
legacy_compatibility.mixed_syntax: Legacy loads plus explicit channel input, or explicit channels plus legacy temporal load controls, are rejected. No disjoint-channel combine mode is implemented.
legacy_compatibility.model_json: No channel fields are injected into or serialized with legacy FiniteElementModel JSON. Historical model serialization shape is unchanged.
legacy_compatibility.unsupported_domain: The adapter requires an admissible PreparedDynamicSystem. Route-local rejection does not change legacy solver admissibility.

sparse_and_lifecycle.distribution_storage: CSC sparse map, one column per channel; no dense ndof-by-channel matrix is retained.
sparse_and_lifecycle.legacy_temporary_memory: GlobalAssembler.assemble_load_vectors currently returns dense vectors; the legacy adapter temporarily receives these existing vectors before storing sparse DOF weights.
sparse_and_lifecycle.snapshot: Channel records, weight tuples and temporal samples are immutable; bound sparse buffers are read-only. Legacy controls are JSON-snapshotted.
sparse_and_lifecycle.binding_validity: A bound object rejects any different operator identity or full DOF signature. Legacy distributed maps also reject binding to a different prepared operator because their integration depends on geometry/formulation.

gate_status.QF0212_G02_GLOBAL: OPEN; overall architecture gate spans other WPs
gate_status.QF0212_G03_DYN: NOT_YET_APPLICABLE; no new physical formulation or response solver

limitations: No PSD, random, spatially complex, or general spectral excitation support.
One harmonic RHS requires a single common frequency; cross-frequency response superposition belongs to consuming analyses.
No implicit unit conversion or generalized-force dimension inference is performed.
No legacy/new disjoint-channel combine mode is implemented; mixed input fails closed.
Legacy load adaptation inherits the existing dense-vector return shape of assemble_load_vectors.
No modal basis, reduced harmonic solver, Newmark modal solver, or uniform base acceleration was implemented.
